- Primary goal: bring inference latency under 60ms p95 for our 6k-token endpoint while keeping costs under target.
- Current infra: mixed G4/RTX workloads, some prefix caching in-house, no quantization yet.
- Constraints: data residency (US), SOC2 compliance in progress.

Next step request: we want a hands-on technical deep-dive with Redwood's ML/infra team (60–90 minutes) to:
1) validate proposed serving topology and potential batching/caching changes,
2) walk through quantization/compatibility options,
3) confirm observability hooks for our critical metrics.

Attendees on our side: myself (Alex), Samir (ML infra lead), plus a product owner. Can you confirm who from Redwood should join?

We are generally available next week (Feb 7–9) in the 09:00–13:00 PT window. If you can propose two time slots and a short agenda we can lock one. Also any pre-call artifacts we should provide (sample payloads, perf traces) let me know and I will share.

Thanks — Alex
